$comment: Every user-facing sentence the hooks emit. Override any subset via rules.messagesPath in config — unlisted keys keep these shipped defaults. {target} and {allowCommand} are filled at runtime.
rewriteInstruction: Rewrite the flagged text per the communication rules, then retry the tool call.
escapeHatch: If a flagged term is a precise domain term in this project, ask the user — if they agree, run: {allowCommand}
warnInstruction: The call was allowed; fix the flagged text per the communication rules.
advisoryLabel: advisories (replace with a measurement or a concrete consequence)
configAskReason: just-say-so: this edits the just-say-so config ({target}). Allow only if you asked for this change.
outputIntro: just-say-so: your last reply contains banned terms:
outputRewrite: Rewrite the reply per the communication rules.
